verdict.rationale: Recurly publishes a developer API portal with official client libraries in seven languages (Ruby, Node.js, Python, .NET, Java, PHP, Go). Its docs also reference real-time checks via the Recurly API, and a public MCP server lets agents work with Recurly's APIs. missing for 10: explicit evidence of the API reference's scope (endpoint coverage, authentication, versioning), independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
